verdict.rationale: Railway's cloud agents give a coding agent a persistent runtime: files stay on the agent's disk and the machine keeps running after you disconnect, with Claude Code and Codex documented as running on that remote machine. Nothing in the evidence shows automatic checkpointing of the agent's state. Deployment rollback is a separate, adjacent feature and earns no credit here. missing for 10: automatic state checkpointing/snapshots of the agent environment, restore-from-checkpoint workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration of cloud-agent persistence.

support.subject: As an ai-native builder, I can give my coding agent a persistent runtime environment that checkpoints its state automatically while working

citations.quote: Your files stay on the agent's disk, and the machine stays running when you disconnect.
Claude Code runs on the remote machine, with its development tools and persistent disk
Codex reads files, runs commands, and makes changes on your cloud agent.
